records.quote: NVIDIA GB10; DGX Spark (GB10 Grace Blackwell, compute capability 12.1, aarch64), llama-server from the ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server-cuda-b9014 image loads qwen3-coder-next-Q4_K_M.gguf successfully, accepts chat completions, but every output token is ? (Unicode U+003F). SHA256 of the GGUF matches upstream. Prompt processing log timings are normal (~220 tok/s prefill). Decode throughput is normal (~63 tok/s).
records.notes: decode throughput reported by issue reporter; server configured with --ctx-size 131072 but measured with a minimal prompt; model output was corrupted (all-? tokens) though throughput was normal

records.quote: The same qwen3-coder-next-Q4_K_M.gguf runs cleanly on RTX 5090 × 2 (Blackwell, sm_120, amd64) at ~74 tok/s decode using the same server-cuda-b9014 image family.
records.notes: dual RTX 5090, amd64; same server-cuda-b9014 image family; cross-platform check cited in the issue
